```{r}

# Load libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

```

Import data

```{r}

# import data

data <- st_read("C:/Users/empurvis/Box/FOCAL/ofo-field-data/1_received-data/0024/data/S123_69d33483b88146e5a856a7c2df9dcabe_SHP/survey.shp") 


```

Plot polygons

```{r}

data_utm <- st_transform(data, 32611) # convert to utm

union <- st_union(st_geometry(data_utm)) # union

singular_poly <- st_convex_hull(union) # convex hull

singular_poly <- st_sf(geometry = singular_poly) # make into sf object

singular_poly$OFO_plot_ID <- 0296 # add OFO plot ID number

for(i in 1:nrow(singular_poly)) {
  polygon_current <- singular_poly[i, ]
  plot_id_current = polygon_current$OFO_plot_ID
  st_write(polygon_current, paste0("C:/Users/empurvis/Box/FOCAL/ofo-field-data/2_standardized-data/field-plot-boundaries/", plot_id_current, ".gpkg"))
} # export

```

Plot data

```{r}

singular_poly$survey_date_approx <- "TRUE"

singular_poly$survey_date <- 20240710

singular_poly$plot_shape <- "irregular"

singular_poly <- st_transform(singular_poly, crs = 32611) # convert to UTMs if needed to calculate area

singular_poly$plot_area <- as.numeric(st_area(singular_poly))

singular_poly$subplots <- "FALSE" # maybe? or maybe we're counting the grid cells as subplots? if so, can use the area functions above to find subplot areas. however, there's only one cell for subplot area in the google sheet- it assumes all subplots in a plot have the same area, which is not true here. 

singular_poly$subplot_shape <- ""

singular_poly$subplot_area <- ""

singular_poly$includes_snags <- "TRUE"

singular_poly$includes_damage <- "FALSE"

singular_poly$damage_codes_inspected <- ""

singular_poly$forest_type <- "185 – Pinyon juniper woodland"

singular_poly$canopy_cover <- ""

singular_poly$min_dbh <- ""

singular_poly$min_dbh_live <- ""

singular_poly$max_dbh_of_primary_trees <- ""

singular_poly$min_ht <- ""

singular_poly$min_dbh_ohvis <- ""

singular_poly$min_ht_ohvis <- ""

singular_poly <- st_transform(singular_poly, crs = 4326) # convert to WGS84 if needed to calculate plot latitude and longitude

poly_centroid <- st_centroid(singular_poly) # find centroid point

centroid_coords <- st_coordinates(poly_centroid) # extract centroid coordinates

singular_poly$plot_longitude <- centroid_coords[, "X"]

singular_poly$plot_latitude <- centroid_coords[, "Y"]

singular_poly$num_ohvis_trees_excluded <- "" 

singular_poly$contributor_plot_id <- "" # just one plot in the dataset, no plot ID number

# export to paste into google sheet field-plots tab

plot_export <- st_drop_geometry(singular_poly)

write.csv(plot_export, "C:/Users/empurvis/Box/FOCAL/field-data-standardization/UCI_Burns_Reserve/plots.csv")

```

Tree data

```{r}

trees <- data

# OFO plot ID numbers

trees$OFO_plot_ID <- "0296"

# tree latitude and tree longitude

# extract the geometry features into columns of lat and long, then merge back into the spatial data frame

trees_coords <- data.frame(trees$'globalid', st_coordinates(trees[,1], st_coordinates(trees[,2]))) %>% rename (tree_lon=X, tree_lat=Y, globalid=trees.globalid)

trees <- full_join(trees, trees_coords, by="globalid")

# tree species

# according to the UCI Burns Reserve website (https://burns.ucnature.org/species-lists/), the only juniper species on the site is the California juniper (Juniperus californica), the pinon pine species on the site is the singleleaf pinon pine (Pinus monophylla), and the only oak species on the site is the desert scrub oak (Quercus cornelius-mulleri)

# FIA codes: 982 = joshua tree, 62 = juniper, 133 = pinon. Despite lots of searching I can't track down a code for the desert scrub oak, so I'll substitute the USDA plant code: QUCO7

trees$species <- ""

trees <- trees %>% mutate(
    species = case_when(
      tree_speci == "Pinon Pine" ~ "133",
      tree_speci == "Joshua Tree" ~ "982",
      tree_speci == "Juniper" ~ "62",
      tree_speci == "Oak" ~ "QUCO7"))

trees$species[trees$tree_spe_1 =="Dead shrub"] <- "0" # code for unknown species

trees$species[trees$tree_spe_1 =="Juniper"] <- "62"

trees$species[trees$tree_spe_1 =="Oak"] <- "QUCO7"

# growth form (all trees except 1 shrub in dataset)

trees$growth_form <- "tree"

trees$growth_form[trees$tree_spe_1 =="Dead shrub"] <- "shrub"

# live/dead

trees$live_dead <- ""

trees <- trees %>% mutate(
    live_dead = case_when(
      tree_statu == "Alive" ~ "L",
      tree_statu == "Alive,Dead" ~ "M",
      tree_statu == "Alive,Unhealthy" ~ "M",
      tree_statu == "Dead" ~ "D",
      tree_statu == "Unhealthy" ~ "M",
      tree_statu == "Unhealthy,Alive" ~ "M",
      tree_statu == "Unsure" ~ "M"))

# notes

trees$notes <- trees$other_note

trees$notes[is.na(trees$notes)] <- ""

# remove downed trees, we only want live and dead standing trees

trees <- trees[trees$tree_struc != "Downed", ] # went from 266 trees to 208 trees. there are still some marginal cases in here (e.g. clumps of trees with one standing and one downed). 

# contributor tree ID

trees$contributor_tree_id <- trees$globalid

# OFO columns that are empty in our dataset

trees$plotid2 <- ""

trees$subplotid <- "" # only if we don't make the grid cells into subplots

trees$height <- ""

trees$height_allometric <- ""

trees$height_above_plot <- ""

trees$dbh <- ""

trees$crown_position <- ""

trees$ohvis <- ""

trees$crown_ratio <- ""

trees$crown_ratio_compacted <- ""

trees$height_to_crown <- ""

trees$height_to_needle <- ""

trees$scorch_height <- ""

trees$percent_prefire_crown_green <- ""

trees$percent_postfire_crown_green <- ""

trees$live_crown_class <- ""

trees$crown_width_1 <- ""

trees$crown_width_2 <- ""

trees$crown_width_allometric <- ""

trees$decay_class <- ""

trees$damage1 <- ""

trees$damage2 <- ""

trees$damage3 <- ""

trees$damage4 <- ""

trees$damage5 <- ""

trees$distance_to_pith <- ""

trees$distance_to_face <- ""

trees$azimuth <- ""

# drop trees without coordinates

trees <- trees[!st_is_empty(trees), ]

# make a new data.frame from sf object

trees_for_export <- st_drop_geometry(trees)

# select columns and put them in order

trees_for_export <- trees_for_export[, c("OFO_plot_ID", "plotid2", "subplotid", "tree_lat", "tree_lon", "height", "height_allometric", "height_above_plot", "dbh", "species", "growth_form", "live_dead", "crown_position", "ohvis", "crown_ratio", "crown_ratio_compacted", "height_to_crown", "height_to_needle", "scorch_height", "percent_prefire_crown_green", "percent_postfire_crown_green", "live_crown_class", "crown_width_1", "crown_width_2", "crown_width_allometric", "decay_class", "damage1", "damage2", "damage3", "damage4", "damage5", "distance_to_pith", "distance_to_face", "azimuth", "contributor_tree_id", "notes" )]

# export

write.csv(trees_for_export, "C:/Users/empurvis/Box/FOCAL/field-data-standardization/UCI_Burns_Reserve/UCIBurns_trees_processed_for_OFO.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")

```
